loading.description: Displays an inline loading spinner and disables user interaction while setting `aria-busy="true"`.
loading.name: loading

contentProps.description:
Props passed through to the inner scrollable `Surface` that wraps the dialog children
(`className`, `ref`, `padding`, `gap`, `align`, ...). The outer `<dialog>` receives the
remaining props.
contentProps.name: contentProps

placement.description:
Where the dialog is anchored within the viewport.
Use `'bottom'` for a bottom sheet or `'left'` / `'right'` for a side sheet (drawer).
placement.name: placement

size.description: Controls the width of the dialog across all placements (or full viewport when `'full'`).
size.name: size

direction.description:
Overrides the inferred swipe direction for dismissing the sheet.
By default, `'bottom'` swipes `'down'`, `'left'` swipes `'left'`, and `'right'` swipes `'right'`.
direction.name: direction

disabled.description: Disables swipe-to-dismiss interaction on the handle.
disabled.name: disabled

threshold.description: Distance in pixels required to dismiss the sheet on release.
threshold.name: threshold

type.description: Semantic type that contextually sets size, line-height, and font weight
type.name: type
